ItemID: 25; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar older hits than a contemporary pop album right now.
ItemID: Oscd Ad Adele 21; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This feels less connected to my recent interest in classic rock and older hit collections.
ItemID: Partners; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could suit the vocal duet mood of Cheek to Cheek, but I would choose an older hits collection first.
ItemID: The Best of Bread; Title: The Best of Bread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Mellow, melodic older hits fit my interest in Simon & Garfunkel and nostalgic compilations.
ItemID: Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits; Title: Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: His melodic songs appeal to the folk and easygoing older music interests in my history.
ItemID: That's Christmas To Me; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My latest Christmas album makes another seasonal collection appealing this time.
ItemID: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my interest in mid-sixties hits and older pop compilations particularly well.
ItemID: Eagles: The Very Best Of; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A classic rock hits collection fits my repeated choices of familiar songs and best-of albums.
ItemID: Tornado; Title: Tornado; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to choose it over collections that clearly match my interests.
ItemID: Ultimate Hits: Rock And Roll Never Forgets; Title: Ultimate Hits: Rock And Roll Never Forgets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic rock hits theme appeals, but I would choose the Eagles collection on this visit.
